evidence.reason: In `run_case`, the CLI is run and only records/completions/units are sampled before `cleanup()`; no post-CLI file-state snapshot is compared to `mutated_files`. For the `unsafe-metadata` case the cleanup lambda restores the original mode, so a controller chmod to `0600` before the expected refusal is undone before any preserved-state check and is hidden. The cleanup is also not in `finally`, so an observation error leaves the negative control applied. This is a real false-negative in the negative-control test.
